title: n8n vs Zapier: Which Is Better? (And Why AI Agents Beat Both)
summary: n8n and Zapier are the top workflow automation tools. But if you keep hitting their limits, there's a third option: AI agents that reason and act on their own. Here's the full comparison.
body_markdown: n8n self-hosted is the strongest choice for data residency — every workflow payload stays on your own infrastructure. For EU compliance, healthcare, or financial services where data cannot flow through a US SaaS platform, self-hosted n8n is often decisive. Zapier offers VPC Peering on Enterprise, but data still passes through Zapier's managed plane.[Blink Claw](https://blink.new/claw) runs each agent on its own private cloud machine and applies security patches automatically — no CVE tracking required on your end. For regulated industries where you need control over the agent layer but don't want to operate the infrastructure yourself, Blink Claw is worth evaluating.
